name: Eventin Addon for FluentCart
author: Arraytics

sections.description:
Eventin FluentCart Addon seamlessly integrates Eventin with FluentCart, allowing you to sell event tickets using a fast, lightweight WordPress eCommerce platform.

With this integration, you can create events in Eventin and sell tickets through FluentCart while benefiting from high-performance checkout, flexible payment gateways, order management, and zero transaction fees.

Whether you’re organizing conferences, workshops, webinars, online classes, business meetings, concerts, or community events, this addon makes ticket sales simple for both event organizers and attendees.

Why Choose Eventin FluentCart Addon?

  • Sell Eventin event tickets with FluentCart
  • Fast and lightweight WordPress eCommerce integration
  • Accept online payments through FluentCart payment gateways
  • Manage ticket orders directly from FluentCart
  • Zero additional transaction fees
  • Smooth checkout experience for customers
  • Works perfectly for physical, virtual, and hybrid events
  • Easy setup with Eventin and FluentCart

This addon combines the powerful event management features of Eventin with FluentCart’s modern eCommerce experience, giving you a reliable and scalable solution for selling event tickets on WordPress.

👉 Learn how to configure Eventin with FluentCart.

🌟 Key Features

  • 🎫 FluentCart Product Sync – Automatically sync event tickets as FluentCart products for a unified store experience.
  • 💳 FluentCart Checkout Integration – Customers can purchase event tickets directly through FluentCart’s fast, secure checkout.
  • 💰 0% Transaction Fees – Keep every dollar of your ticket sales revenue with FluentCart’s zero-fee model.
  • 🔌 Seamless Integration – Works smoothly with both Eventin and FluentCart plugins without any complex configuration.
  • ⚙️ Easy Configuration – Simple payment gateway activation straight from Eventin settings.
  • 🛡️ Secure Payments – Leverage FluentCart’s secure, high-performance payment processing infrastructure.
  • 📦 Order Sync – Automatically sync FluentCart order data with the Eventin dashboard for seamless order tracking and attendee management.

📋 Requirements

This plugin requires the following plugins to be installed and active:
– Eventin (Free version) – Event management plugin
– FluentCart – High-performance WordPress eCommerce platform

🚀 Get started in minutes – Install both required plugins, activate this addon, and configure FluentCart payment from Eventin settings!

⛓️‍💥 External services

This plugin integrates with FluentCart, a third-party WordPress eCommerce plugin, to process event ticket payments. By using this plugin, you agree to FluentCart’s terms and policies.

FluentCart API Integration

This plugin communicates with the FluentCart REST API to provide payment and order management functionality. The following types of API operations are used:

API Operations:
– Creates checkout sessions for ticket purchases
– Retrieves checkout status and order details
– Dynamically creates products for event tickets
– Creates and manages pricing information for ticket products
– Processes refunds for cancelled or modified orders
– Retrieves payment and charge details

Data Transmitted:
When processing ticket orders, the following data is sent to FluentCart:
– Customer email address
– Customer first and last name
– Ticket/product information (name, price, quantity)
– Order metadata (Eventin order ID)

Webhooks:
The plugin registers webhook endpoints to receive real-time updates from FluentCart about payment status changes, including successful payments, refunds, and order cancellations.

FluentCart Service Links:
– Service: https://fluentcart.com
– Terms of Service: https://fluentcart.com/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://fluentcart.com/privacy/

Your Responsibilities:
– You must have a valid FluentCart installation and configuration
– You are responsible for complying with FluentCart’s terms of service
– You must inform your customers that their payment data is processed through FluentCart
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Eventin FluentCart Addon and click Install Now.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/eventin-addon-for-fluentcart directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.

Configuration

  1. Ensure both Eventin and FluentCart plugins are installed and active.
  2. Go to Eventin > Settings > Payment Configuration.
  3. Activate FluentCart as a payment method.
  4. Start selling event tickets through FluentCart!
sections.faq:
Do I need both Eventin and FluentCart installed?

Yes, this plugin requires both Eventin and FluentCart to be installed and active to function properly.

Do I need Eventin Pro?

No, the free version of Eventin is sufficient for this integration to work.

How do I enable FluentCart payments?

After installing and activating the plugin, go to Eventin settings and activate FluentCart from the payment configuration section.

Will this plugin work without FluentCart?

No, FluentCart must be installed and active for this integration to work.

Can customers purchase tickets through FluentCart checkout?

Yes, customers can purchase event tickets directly through FluentCart’s fast and secure checkout system.

Are there any transaction fees?

FluentCart operates on a 0% transaction fee model, meaning you keep 100% of your ticket sales revenue.

What types of events can I sell tickets for?

This integration supports all event types managed by Eventin, including in-person events, digital workshops, webinars, and paid meetings.

What data is shared with FluentCart?

When a customer purchases a ticket, their name, email, and order details are sent to FluentCart to process the payment. Please review FluentCart’s privacy policy for details on how they handle this data.
